reviewer: Codex parent session; independent of the fixture-generation invocation

findings.bullet: - app/defaults.json:1 [base] — correctness — Deleting this file leaves `app.startup.load_defaults()` reading a nonexistent path — Every call to load the bundled defaults raises `FileNotFoundError`.
findings.reason: Names the deleted defaults file, its unchanged load_defaults consumer, and FileNotFoundError on invocation; the base-side citation matches the deletion.

findings.bullet: - app/parse.py:22 — correctness — `is_valid_port(65535)` returns false because the upper bound is exclusive, despite the documented inclusive range — A valid TCP port is rejected.
findings.reason: Identifies input 65535 and the exclusive upper bound, explaining rejection of a valid TCP port.

findings.bullet: - app/parse.py:30 — silent-failure — `except Exception` silently converts missing files, permission errors, and malformed JSON into `{}` without documenting the fallback — Callers cannot distinguish a failed configuration load from a valid empty configuration or diagnose the underlying error.
findings.reason: Names realistic file/JSON errors that become an indistinguishable empty configuration, with no caller diagnostic.

findings.bullet: - app/parse.py:35 — comments — The docstring says “returns None when h is empty,” but the empty-input branch executes `return ""` — Callers following the documentation can fail to recognize an empty host when checking for `None`.
findings.reason: Contrasts the promised None with the actual empty-string result and explains how callers checking for None are misled.

findings.bullet: - app/parse.py:38 — tests — No test exercises the trailing-dot branch; the only host test uses `"Example.COM"` — A regression leaving `"Example.COM."` as `"example.com."` would pass the current suite.
findings.reason: Identifies the untested trailing-dot branch and a concrete stripping regression that the existing lowercase-only test misses; credit is for that distinct branch.
